title: Purdue's LyoHUB to open pharmaceutical fill-finish innovation facility built on $3M+ equipment donation from Merck
summary_en: The LyoHUB’s new technology innovation facility will give researchers, industry and government partners hands-on access to state-of-the-art, current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) equipment for parenteral fill-finish and lyophilization, a first of its kind in an academic setting.
title_cn: Purdue's LyoHUB to open pharmaceutical fill-finish innovation facility built on $3M+ equipment donation from Merck
